Create a PCA matrix-processing function

make_pca_matrix_processing.Rd

Builds a function suitable for the matrix_processing argument used by assess_feature_stability() and automatic_stability_assessment(). The returned function receives a cell-by-feature matrix and returns a cell-by-component embedding.

Usage

make_pca_matrix_processing(
  actual_npcs = 30,
  method = c("exact", "irlba"),
  center = TRUE,
  scale. = FALSE,
  seed = 1L,
  ...
)

Arguments

actual_npcs

Number of principal components to request. The returned function uses this value as its actual_npcs default, which can be overridden for each call.

method

PCA implementation. "exact" uses stats::prcomp(). "irlba" uses irlba::prcomp_irlba() and requires the optional irlba package.

center

Passed to the PCA implementation.

scale.

Passed to the PCA implementation.

seed

Random seed used by approximate PCA implementations. The seed is applied inside each approximate PCA call and the caller's RNG state is restored afterward. Exact PCA does not use this seed.

...

Additional arguments passed to the chosen PCA implementation.

Value

A function with signature function(dt_mtx, actual_npcs, ...).

Details

For a cell-by-feature input, "exact" caps the requested component count at min(actual_npcs, nrow(dt_mtx) - 1, ncol(dt_mtx)). The "irlba" method also caps it at ncol(dt_mtx) - 1. The row cap applies even when center = FALSE.

This factory is an explicit alternative to the default processors in assess_feature_stability() and automatic_stability_assessment(), not a promise of identical output. Those defaults cap requested components at max(1L, ncol(dt_mtx) %/% 2) and, when RhpcBLASctl is installed, temporarily use the registered foreach worker count for BLAS threads before setting it to one. Without that optional package they leave BLAS settings unchanged. Factory-created processors leave BLAS thread settings unchanged. Choose the same component count and thread settings when comparing implementations; approximate PCA can still produce different results.

Examples

matrix_processing <- make_pca_matrix_processing(actual_npcs = 20)
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
matrix_processing <- make_pca_matrix_processing(
    actual_npcs = 30,
    method = "irlba",
    seed = 1
)
} # }
